typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFullPath as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DestinationFileName as string (),
	DestinationFullPath as string (),
	DestinationPath as string (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	Email_Recipients_cc as string (),
	Error_Email_Recipients as string (),
	Error_Email_Recipients_cc as string (),
	Getdatepart as string (),
	MarketCode as string (),
	Report_Dt as string (),
	Src_Qry as string (),
	StoredProcName as string ()
}

source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::Src_Qry',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet)) ~> FlatFileDestination
